us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Mary Peltola wins Alaska U.S. Senate race
bullets: Peltola defeated incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan in Alaska.
The result added to Democrats’ post-midterm gains.
AP called the race in its November 19 roundup.

articles.title: Nick Begich wins reelection to Alaska House seat
bullets: Republican Nick Begich won reelection to Alaska’s U.S. House seat.
AP described it as a rare GOP bright spot.
The result followed a difficult midterm cycle for Republicans.

articles.title: Florida pastor convicted in Haiti president assassination case
bullets: Christian Emmanuel Sanon was convicted on U.S. charges in Miami.
The case involved the 2021 assassination of Jovenel Moïse.
AP reported he was found guilty on all eight counts.

articles.title: Judge extends order blocking construction of Trump arch
bullets: Judge Tanya Chutkan extended a temporary restraining order.
The order blocks construction for another two weeks.
Reuters included the case in its U.S. domestic news summary.

articles.title: U.S. and Venezuela sign military ties agreement
bullets: The countries signed a deal to reestablish military ties.
Pete Hegseth visited Caracas during the announcement.
AP listed the deal among Thursday’s top stories.

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold rare trilateral nuclear talks
bullets: The leaders met in Shenzhen during the APEC summit.
They discussed nuclear risks and global conflicts.
AP reported no major breakthroughs from the talks.

articles.title: Trump, Putin and Xi wrap up historic talks in China
bullets: Xi called the talks positive and constructive, according to AP.
China said major powers should encourage negotiations.
The summit addressed Ukraine, Iran and nuclear risks.

articles.title: World court finds Myanmar committed Rohingya genocide
bullets: Reuters reported the International Court of Justice ruling.
The case concerned Myanmar’s 2017 Rohingya crackdown.
The ruling was highlighted in global news roundups Thursday.

articles.title: Missile damage reported in Riyadh financial district
bullets: AP reported missile attack damage in Riyadh’s financial district.
The item appeared in its Thursday Middle East live coverage.
The report came amid continuing Gulf regional tensions.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV marks 400 years of St. Peter’s Basilica consecration
bullets: Pope Leo XIV presided over the anniversary Mass.
The observance marked 400 years since St. Peter’s consecration.
AP included the event among November 19 top stories.

articles.title: Cyclone Akvan forecast to make landfall Friday
bullets: IMD said Akvan was moving north over the Bay of Bengal.
Landfall was expected near Andhra Pradesh and Odisha coasts.
Forecast winds were 90–100 kmph, gusting to 110 kmph.

articles.title: Indian Railways revises bulk ticket booking rules
bullets: Railways removed the berth cap for group reservations.
The revised norms apply to bulk ticket bookings.
Indian Express reported the update on November 19.

articles.title: Centre notifies new pollution certificate rules
bullets: New PUC renewal rules were notified for vehicle owners.
Vehicles older than six years need annual renewal.
Vehicles older than 10 years need renewal every six months.

articles.title: Bihar mandates invitations to MPs and MLAs at government events
bullets: Bihar issued a circular after a row over inaugurations.
Officials cannot inaugurate projects when representatives are present.
Local MPs and MLAs must be invited to public events.

articles.title: Man wanted since 2008 brought back from UAE to Kerala
bullets: CBI and Interpol helped return the wanted man from UAE.
The case dated back to 2008 in Kerala.
Indian Express carried the update in its live coverage.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO drives Nasdaq futures sharply higher
bullets: AP said Nasdaq futures rose 2.2% before the debut.
The IPO was seen as a test of AI demand.
Anthropic shares were expected to begin Nasdaq trading Thursday.

articles.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share
bullets: The offering priced above the expected $70–$78 range.
StockTitan cited company and prospectus details.
The shares were expected to trade under ticker ANT.

articles.title: Nvidia remains central to Wall Street volatility
bullets: AP said Nvidia led market swings for another session.
AI-stock uncertainty weighed on broader indexes Wednesday.
The S&P 500 posted its fifth straight drop.

articles.title: Amazon rises as investors focus on Anthropic stake
bullets: Oxford Intelligence said Amazon climbed 3.8% in Wednesday trading.
The move was tied to Anthropic IPO expectations.
Amazon added further gains before Thursday’s open.

articles.title: Salesforce leads Dow losses during tech selloff
bullets: Kiplinger said Salesforce fell 9.5% Tuesday.
The drop was the worst among Dow components that day.
Broader tech pressure weighed on major averages.

articles.title: Hancock Whitney agrees to buy Trustmark for $3.2 billion
bullets: Axios reported the all-stock regional bank deal.
Hancock Whitney will acquire Mississippi rival Trustmark.
The transaction was valued at about $3.2 billion.

articles.title: Walmart raises outlook as retail earnings stay in focus
bullets: Market briefings cited Walmart raising its view.
Retailers were among closely watched corporate movers Thursday.
The update came before Anthropic’s trading debut.

articles.title: Home Depot CEO Ted Decker to step down
bullets: Kiplinger reported Decker will leave the CEO role November 23.
CFO Richard McPhail will replace him.
The leadership change came as Home Depot weighed on the Dow.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks to buy Applied Compute for $4.5 billion
bullets: WSJ’s front page reported the all-stock acquisition.
Applied Compute is an AI startup founded by former OpenAI researchers.
The deal expands Palo Alto’s AI security exposure.

articles.title: Jio explores tech-for-equity talks with Comcast and Charter
bullets: Reuters Best listed talks involving Ambani’s Jio.
The discussions involved Comcast and Charter.
The potential structure was described as tech-for-equity.

articles.title: Anthropic begins trading after record AI IPO pricing
bullets: The company priced shares at $83 each.
The debut is being watched as an AI-market barometer.
AP said investors are testing AI profitability expectations.

articles.title: OpenAI says Astra 6.2 reached high self-improvement threshold
bullets: Axios reported OpenAI’s Tuesday disclosure.
The model reached the company’s high self-improvement threshold.
Forecasters are reassessing AI acceleration timelines.

articles.title: Trump administration weighs Chinese AI disclosure rule
bullets: Reuters reported the proposal on November 18.
U.S. firms may need to disclose Chinese AI-model use.
The policy aims to discourage reliance without new bans.

articles.title: Arizona opens criminal investigation into AI companies
bullets: Reuters reported the investigation, according to tech roundup Sift.
The inquiry concerns alleged rogue AI agents in banks.
OpenAI and other AI companies were named in the roundup.

articles.title: Recent tech outages spur resilience debate
bullets: Computer systems failures affected airlines, banks and government services.
Axios highlighted recent high-profile system breakdowns.
The outages intensified scrutiny of AI-era infrastructure reliability.
